items.html: You also know that every light in the world has an aspect of reflected light. And if so, this light that protruded at the forehead and came out in the secret of the Tefillin of the head must have a reflected light through its back side, which is at the nape, where stand those ends of the hairs of Arich Anpin, striking and shining there, as above; for from their power came out the light of the Tefillin of the head, and now it has a reflected light reaching there.
